# Recreation Prompt
Create a self-contained browser canvas game titled **Sunny Spore Kingdom Run**. Preserve the source as a side-view tile platformer/editor: momentum-based left/right movement, gravity, jump, solid tile collision, hazard death/respawn, goal win overlay, spawn tiles, story course list, editor palette, base64 course import/export, keyboard controls, and mobile touch controls. Transform presentation into a family-friendly mushroom-kingdom arcade adventure with Captain Cap as the focal actor, bright hills and clouds, brick/question-block platforms, goofy chomper hazards, star gates, cheerful feedback, readable mobile HUD, and large tappable controls. Use approved catalog fonts/audio only and prefer procedural CSS/canvas art over external images.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: side-view tile platformer with a course editor and shareable/importable level code
- objective: start from a placed spawn tile, traverse solid tile platforms, avoid hazard tiles, and touch the goal tile to trigger the win overlay
- input model: keyboard left/right/jump plus mobile touch buttons for left, right, and jump; editor uses pointer/touch placement on the canvas
- core loop: select a story/editor course, reset the player at the start tile, apply momentum/friction/gravity each frame, collide against solid tiles, die on hazards or falling, win on goal contact, and return to menu/map/editor
- fail/friction state: hazard contact or falling below the level triggers a brief defeat effect and automatic respawn; winning opens a modal with a next-course action

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve momentum-based horizontal acceleration, friction damping, gravity, jump force, and camera follow smoothing.
- Preserve tile meanings: 1 solid platform, 2 hazard, 3 goal, 4 spawn/start.
- Preserve rectangular collision checks, tile-size grid, editor palette placement, import/export base64 JSON course format, story level data, win/fail semantics, and mobile left/right/jump controls.
- Preserve start/play/editor/import/map/win state flow and restart behavior after defeat.

## Remixed target
Sunny Spore Kingdom Run reinterprets the same protected platformer/editor as a bright mushroom-road adventure starring Captain Cap. Solid tiles become bouncy brick/question blocks, hazards become silly chomper critters, spawn tiles become mushroom starts, and goals become sparkling star gates. The rebuild uses a self-contained canvas/CSS surface with stronger mobile-first HUD readability and procedural mushroom-kingdom scene ownership while leaving the underlying platform physics and course semantics intact.
